The Higgsfield Plugin lets you create images and videos directly in ChatGPT. It gives your ChatGPT conversations access to Higgsfield's creative models without leaving the chat.

Open the ChatGPT Plugins Directory, find Higgsfield, click Add, and sign in with your Higgsfield account. Then you can start creating in a new ChatGPT conversation.

You can create images and videos from text prompts, reference images, or both. The plugin gives you access to Higgsfield's image and video models directly in ChatGPT.

Higgsfield generations in ChatGPT use the same credit system as the Higgsfield platform. Each generation costs credits based on the selected model and resolution.
